description.value: Established in 1998, Vancouver Whale Watch is the original whale watching company in Vancouver, departing from the historic fishing village of Steveston in Richmond. Tours run 3 to 5 hours through the Gulf Islands and Strait of Georgia aboard a fleet of zodiacs, with professional wildlife guides focused on Orcas, Humpback Whales, and other marine life. The company boasts a 98% whale sighting rate and offers a lifetime free return guarantee if no whale is spotted.
